LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.label: Mech Assault Shotgun
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.description:
A fully automatic shotgun able to be mass-produced with stamped components.
This weapon is specially designed for automatroid use, normal humans will struggle to use it without external equipment or augmentations.
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.tools.barrel.label: barrel
The standard three round burst of pellets. Nothing clever about it, and nothing unarmored enjoys standing in front of it.
A single rifled slug in place of the pellet spread. It reaches far further and punches through light plating, at the cost of one projectile per trigger pull.
A sabot load of tungsten-cored darts. Each one carries almost no mass, so flesh barely notices them, but five of them per pull will find their way through plating that shrugs off buckshot outright.

Zirconium pellets that ignite as they leave the barrel. The burning cloud carries only a few paces and does little damage by itself, but four shells of it will set a corridor alight and keep anything from walking down it.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Dragon.label: 12 gauge dragon's breath
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Dragon.descrip: A shell packed with zirconium pellets that ignite the moment they clear the muzzle. The burning cloud spends itself within a few paces, which is exactly the distance the loader cares about.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Flechette.desc: A sabot shell holding a bundle of tungsten-cored darts. Each dart carries almost no mass and does little to soft tissue, but the cores hold together against plating that stops a lead pellet cold.
